title: Street Smarts & Range Responsibility
body:
💥🛡️ Yo GAFC fam, let's keep it 💯 on gun safety! Gloxsie 21 always says, 'Know your target and what's BEYOND it!'🎯 That ain't just range talk, that's life. 

Bobo Licious learned this the hard way (luckily, just a close call!). He thought he was clear, but Gloxsie spotted somethin' sneaky behind his target. Good thing Bobo listens! 🙏

Being a responsible gun owner means protecting your blessings & your community. It’s about stewardship, plain and simple. 

Quick Poll: You're lined up, target acquired. What's the LAST thing you double-check before the shot?
A) Your grip & stance
B) EVERYTHING behind your target
C) Your sight alignment
D) Your quick draw speed

Drop your answer below & tell us why! Let's build that legacy of safety together.

#GAFC #GunSafety #CommunityFirst #ProtectYourBlessings #KnowYourTarget #FirearmResponsibility #StreetSmartSafety #GloxsieAndBobo
